title: The Empty Place Beside the Crust

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The fire keeps what it is given. The shelf keeps what is taken. Nobody under the roof counts the space between.
epigraph.attribution: A hearth-saying of Low Kiln, told to the coals

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and seventy-two to three hundred and seventy-four days, six months and one hundred and ninety-two to one hundred and ninety-four days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. As in chapters 25 through 106 the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break and no tagged memory. The register takes the body each morning in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it with neither an order to go farther nor an order to go away; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. He reads the household as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. This chapter lives the three ordinary tending days after the Hearth Drawing: the kiln in its winter rhythm, the yard going around its seven walked-around places with the returning-line place widest, the hearth grammar at both ends, the twice-mended pot kept apart from restoration, the dressed grain covered and unfigured. Ilva keeps her firings in wood at the well on the first morning; Hessa Rale passes on the clay road on the second with a slate she does not read. The chapter's one movement is Sella Vail's, on the third evening: setting him on his bed, she tucks the wool into the empty place beside the crust — no third crust, no name, no word, no look at his face — and the boy files it on a place of its own beside the fold's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the pan's gone ring and the field's empty place, expressly not a joining of rooms, not a third crust, not a gift, not a payment, no payer, not a sixth held object and not a rule, gathering interest toward the far-off finger. Ten arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure with the figure read still not the figure paid and no doctrine out of ten; the Drawing's flat knock stays outside the six hearings with the seventh place empty; the four rooms with the same gap stay apart with a finger between every pair; nine record-first hands and nine stoppings keep no tenth; the widow's mark is untouched and no eighth opening is made due. The infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle stays louder than the surgeon's knowing; neither wins, and the argument is the work.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Morning After the Drawing
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{372}{Stone 13, Thirdday, Y.H. 813}: small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the morning of the first ordinary day after the Hearth Drawing, with the hand laid flat on answer 318 and the count exact at 371 carried forward and not spent. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, runner, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards. No recap of Stone 10, 11 or 12: nothing from the tenth reading or the Drawing crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer — the flat knock stays on its own place outside the six hearings with the seventh place empty, the four rooms with the same gap stay apart, the collector's ordinary hand stays on its own tray joined to none, ten arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure and no doctrine came out of ten. Dramatic purpose: prove the ordinary day resumes with no residue. The surgeon takes the body in the old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and wrist, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform — and the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar under lead glaze with her hand half over nothing; the twice-mended pot is lifted thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to the pot and the fire and never to a person, repair kept apart from restoration; the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured, fingers in and out without closing; the pot rim is set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). Garl stays in objects, salt coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey thaw, uncalled tile debt, name unspoken 372 days; the carried fire answers four low pulls with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed 372 days (T009/T013/T092, T088). The river's winter skin is found where put on its own place beside water-over-water and is not spent on any date (T083/T085). The hand comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the ice, lets it go and lays itself back flat on the fold — answer 319, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment. Last image: the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 319, the crust's hair-lifted corner, the empty place beside it unnamed, the river low over lower under its winter skin.

scenes.title: The Count in Wood
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 13 through the going of the light and the small hours at the close of the day. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Ilva at the yard well, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and damper; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier, a cracked-jar man in a rope sling, a woman with kindling and two fence-menders. No Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no ownerless voice — the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: the district's private keepings are all present and none is made to stand up and call itself an account. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire she will bank against their coming back and never to the basket, goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out; the gone white frost, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, not a fourth covering, and the river's skin is found where put and not spent (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). At the yard well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Stone cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam she does not scrub out; her hand goes to her sleeve before her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both with a half-beat, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. The notched birch strip is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined, no figure comes off the wood, and the boy files her order of reaching as the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth, files no tenth, makes no reader of her keeping and expressly makes her the speaker of no voice (T080 advanced, not paid). The day's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: the hare's cost goes to the weather that carried the snow, the cracked jar to a pot that says nothing, and to the woman with kindling and the two fence-menders arguing an early and a late thaw Tarn says Yes, house to each and keeps the late because it puts off the paying (T077). At the kindling six stand in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence; the knife lies at the very edge of its sill, hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach; he tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, finds the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting where they were put and makes neither again, checks the pale clip-ring at his left wrist, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, and does not look along the road (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and white in a fist-crease, not bone-coloured slip; three or more men unnamed go low into the back room before first grey and get no name and no word that the room is cold; he parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel before any person (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady) and tells a pot You'll do, withholds the full note three turns ahead, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence — one iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word for both — taking it out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light she sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, lets her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and leaves the thread where it lay; the fire keeps four pulls and its gap with its payer unnamed 372 days; the hand comes down on answer 320. Last image: hand laid back flat on the fold on answer 320, the crust's corner a hair off the wool, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the wrist-joint, the count at 372 exact.

scenes.title: The Woman Who Carries
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{373}{Stone 14, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: small hours under the Vail roof into a wholly ordinary morning, then the Clay Yard and the clay road in the afternoon. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Hessa Rale as a single road sighting; Garl in objects. No Ilva, Berr, collector, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice. New day, new date and no recap: nothing from Stone 13 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the hand comes down on answer 320 and the count stands 372 exact carried forward. Dramatic purpose: a carrier passes with a record she will not read, and the boy refuses to join sighting to saying. Open on the surgeon's inventory of the body in the old order with the surgeon/infant quarrel renewed and neither verdict (T060/T086); Sella's morning grammar — hearth before basket, coals told the thaw, The house will keep it, dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure or handful, twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, finger on top of the shelf so the charcoal stays unread; the widow's mark is untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule and no eighth is made due (T058/T079/T100, T077). The yard goes around its seven walked-around places, returning-line widest, with a look and a wide step and no number; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and the river's winter skin is found where put beside water-over-water, not a fourth covering, not a sixth low thing, not spent on any date (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). In the afternoon Hessa Rale comes down the clay road in the boy's sight with Berr Clay's narrow slate held edge-on to her forearm, the writing turned toward her own sleeve, the second strap let out for the long road and dried pale scurf of road-mud unbrushed on the shortened skirt; the small flat correction of the strap and the turn of the wrist come first, her hand goes to the slate before her eyes go to the yard, the thumb lies along the grain of the frame and nothing presses where the writing is, and she goes on with the pace of a person who has made a bargain with distance; no figure comes off the slate and she is a runner and not a reader. The boy files the turning of the writing toward herself on a place of its own beside the Ash 6 sighting, expressly not a fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying, not a witness, not a confession, not a payment and not joined to Ilva's strip, Berr's thumb, the charcoal or any other private keeping; her eighth record-first hand stays eight with no tenth (T080 advanced, not paid). No ownerless word came over the boards; the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions held apart (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). The four rooms with the same gap — the birth room, the Vail kiln-house, the market-day slate room and the Drawing house seen two doors down — are held apart on a place of their own with a finger between every pair, advanced and not paid (T081). The hand comes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake, holds it whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go and lays itself back on answer 321. Last image: the slate's writing turned to the sleeve going down the clay road while the boy watches from the basket's low angle, and the hand laid down on answer 321 in the small hours.

scenes.title: Four Rooms With the Same Gap
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 14 through the going of the light and the small hours at the close of the day. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier, a cracked-jar man, a woman with kindling and two fence-menders. No Hessa after the afternoon road sighting, no Ilva, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no ownerless voice — the three Ash directions stand where put and do not repeat (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: the likeness of four rooms gathers weight without any hand laying it across the household's not-doings. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, widest around the returning-line place, keeps the three coverings as weather entered nowhere and the river's skin found where put and not spent (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085); the dressed grain stays covered and unfigured with no handful, the twice-mended pot keeps its hairline showing, the charcoal stays unread beneath her finger, and the widow's mark hangs untouched (T077, T058/T079/T100). At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, passes over the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting as a man passes over tools put back where they belong and makes neither again, says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while keeping the late because it puts off the paying, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; the equality under the roof holds where it moved to, two ears and two silences and a loan that can hear and has never been called, with no payer named and no slate entered (T036/T076/T006). Jorra keeps the wheel-shed edge, comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and a white fist-crease, gives the unnamed men in the back room no name and no word that the room is cold, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note he knows three turns ahead from any High Kiln master, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one iron with two bites taken out without leaving the holding of Ash 26 a second time, gathered once and not made again (T062/T035/T031); he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn. The boy keeps the four rooms with the same gap on a place of their own with a finger between every pair — four likenesses and not one account, an account wanting a hand to lay them together and a payer under all four, and no such hand standing and no such payer — advanced and not paid, not joined to the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings, the well-saying at four shapings or the Ash directions (T081). Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the Drawing's flat knock on its own place outside them, six answers on the sixth place with no doctrine among them; the carried fire keeps four pulls and its gap with its payer unnamed 373 days; ten arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure and no doctrine comes out of ten (T061/T082, T088, T015/T041/T047 held). The file comes out on the towel with every gap left gap; the hand comes down on answer 322, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air. Last image: the file open on the towel at the head of the bed with every gap left gap and the hand laid back flat on answer 322.

scenes.title: The Place Beside the Crust
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{374}{Stone 15, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: small hours under the Vail roof into the third ordinary tending morning, with the hand laid flat on answer 322 and the count exact at 373 carried forward and not spent. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, runner, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice. New day, new date and no recap: nothing from Stone 13 or 14 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: hold the empty place still for one morning so the evening's small keeping is a change and not a habit. The surgeon takes the body in the old order — the leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). On this morning the empty place beside the crust is left exactly as it was on the two mornings before — no hand at it, no third crust, no name spoken over it — and the boy keeps it on a place of its own beside the loaf shelf's two gaps, the gone shallow pan's round ring and the field's empty place, with a finger between every pair and no third gap made (T060/T086/T097 held, not paid). The widow's mark is untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule; the river's winter skin is found where put beside water-over-water and not spent on any date (T058/T079, T083/T085). Stone keeps its fifteenth day without a boundary drawn, the older women naming the month by weather and the slatemen by Account-days with neither habit set right or left, and the boy keeps 374 exact without standing it up as a threshold (T071/T072). The hand comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go and lays itself back on answer 323, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082). Last image: the hand laid down on answer 323, the stiff crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it still unnamed and no third.

scenes.title: What the Hand Left at the Fold
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 15, the carry home at the going of the light, the hearth grammar renewed under the Vail roof, the pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel, then the small hours at the very end of the day. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn and Jorra Vail in the afternoon; Garl in objects. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no ownerless voice — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions stand where put and do not repeat (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: the chapter's one meaningful change, a small keeping at the fold that gathers interest and is not paid. The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere and the river's skin stays on its own place beside water-over-water, found where put and not spent (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). At the kindling Tarn keeps six and the seventh beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, finds the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting where they were put and makes neither again, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, and does not look along the road (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note three turns ahead, and lets his bent finger lead at the cold damper without leaving the holding of Ash 26 a second time; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). **The one change, T060/T086/T097 advanced and NOT paid:** at the going of the light she carries him up the nineteen steps, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face — and her hand tucks the wool into the empty place beside the crust, a small keeping done with no word, no third crust, no name for the place, no look toward his face. She lets her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it goes away and leaves the thread frozen and unwiped. The boy takes the interval apart by what was there and by what was not and files it on a place of its own beside the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the pan's gone ring and the field's empty place: expressly not a joining of rooms, not a third crust, not a gift (a gift wants a giver and nobody gave), not a payment, no payer standing, not a sixth held object and not a seventh or eighth, not a habit, a way, a sign, a hearing, a mending, a cause or a rule, gathered once and not made again, found where put, gathering interest toward the far-off finger that will one day lay the shelf and the fold together (T097 held for that far-off day, advanced and not paid). The surgeon reads it as a hand at the edge of a wound that closes nothing, exact and worth nothing; the infant wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped; both true, the second louder, neither winning. The hearth grammar is renewed: coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, The house will keep it, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to the pot and the fire, the dressed grain covered and unfigured with no handful, the charcoal unread beneath her finger and her lips on a two-gapped row figuring neither gap, the widow's mark untouched because a going of the light and a bed are not openings and no eighth is made due (T058/T079/T100, T077). Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the Drawing's flat knock outside them, nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, ten arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with the figure read still not the figure paid and no doctrine out of ten; the four rooms with the same gap stay held apart with a finger between every pair, advanced and not paid (T061/T082, T081, T015/T041/T047 held). The file comes out on the towel with every gap left gap. The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ended and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking — answer 324, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across none of the kept things. Count **374 exact**, six months and one hundred and ninety-four days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number; Stone kept its fifteenth day without a boundary drawn, the deep-winter month held, and the count went on. Last image: the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 324, the crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool and the wool tucked into the place beside it, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform, the boards keeping four nails, four and a thumb-width knot, the carried fire four pulls and a silence, the river low over lower under its winter skin, and the count at 374 exact — forward, not closed.
